title: Tutorial
description: Step-by-step tutorial or instructional content with difficulty level, duration, author, and user ratings. Used for learning platforms, documentation sites, and educational content.

title.description: Title of the tutorial (e.g., Introduction to React, Python Basics)

description.description: Brief description of what the tutorial teaches

difficulty.description: Difficulty level (e.g., beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert)

duration.description: Estimated time to complete the tutorial in minutes

author.description: Full name of the tutorial author or instructor

steps.description: Array of step-by-step instructions or lesson titles

rating.description: Average user rating, typically on a scale of 1-5
